subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord keep a channel-level bounded retry after the shared reply-session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should that shared recovery be the sole owner of this conflict?
rationale: Both changes target the same session initialization conflict at different ownership layers; choosing the permanent recovery boundary affects retry timing, replay settlement, and future sibling-channel consistency.

options.title: Land Shared Recovery First
options.body: Review the shared self-heal first, retest Discord thread replies, and retain a Discord retry only if conflicts can still escape the shared boundary.

options.title: Keep Layered Discord Defense
options.body: Require this PR to use prepare-once dispatch retries and typed replay release as a deliberate channel-level defense in addition to shared recovery.

options.title: Pause Discord Patch
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want all conflict recovery owned exclusively by shared session initialization.

recommendation.title: Land Shared Recovery First
recommendation.body: Review the shared self-heal first, retest Discord thread replies, and retain a Discord retry only if conflicts can still escape the shared boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the reply-session initialization and session-storage boundary most recently maintained in this area.
